item.title: Dell Alienware Support: A $5,000 Frustration
item.description: Dell still hasn’t gotten my Alienware x17 r2 fixed. It was repaired, lasted a few days, and then died again. When I try to get help with it, I am going through an uncoordinated mess where I am just going around in circles.
